sentences.say: On this day in eighteen sixty-nine, two men tried to corner America's gold.
sentences.show: On this day in 1869, two men tried to corner America's gold.

sentences.say: Jay Gould and James Fisk formed the Gold Ring, to force up the price on the New York Gold Exchange.
sentences.show: Jay Gould and James Fisk formed the Gold Ring, to force up the price on the New York Gold Exchange.

sentences.say: Their inside man? The President's own brother-in-law.
sentences.show: Their inside man? The President's own brother-in-law.

sentences.say: But President Grant ordered the Treasury to sell gold, and the price plummeted.
sentences.show: But President Grant ordered the Treasury to sell gold, and the price plummeted.
